index idx_dot_memories_dot_content: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_dot_memories_dot_content ON dot_memories (dot_id, content) WHERE dot_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dot_memories_dot_created: CREATE INDEX idx_dot_memories_dot_created ON dot_memories (dot_id, created_at DESC) WHERE dot_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dot_memories_organization_content: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_dot_memories_organization_content ON dot_memories (organization_id, content) WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dot_memories_organization_created: CREATE INDEX idx_dot_memories_organization_created ON dot_memories (organization_id, created_at DESC) WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dot_workspace_cleanup_due: CREATE INDEX idx_dot_workspace_cleanup_due ON dot_workspace_cleanup (next_attempt_at)
index idx_dots_organization_active: CREATE INDEX idx_dots_organization_active ON dots (organization_id, active) WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dots_organization_name: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_dots_organization_name ON dots (organization_id, name) WHERE organization_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dots_user_active: CREATE INDEX idx_dots_user_active ON dots (owner_user_id, active) WHERE owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_dots_user_name: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_dots_user_name ON dots (owner_user_id, name) WHERE owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_organization_groups_group: CREATE INDEX idx_organization_groups_group ON organization_groups (gateway_group)
table dot_memories: CREATE TABLE dot_memories ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, dot_id TEXT REFERENCES dots(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, organization_id TEXT REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('preference', 'project', 'fact')), content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK ((dot_id IS NOT NULL) <> (organization_id IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT
table dot_workspace_cleanup: CREATE TABLE dot_workspace_cleanup ( dot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), claim_token TEXT, claim_until TEXT, last_error_code TEXT CHECK (last_error_code IN ('unavailable', 'conflict', 'failed')), CHECK ((claim_token IS NULL) = (claim_until IS NULL)) ) STRICT
table dots: CREATE TABLE dots ( principal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, owner_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, organization_id TEXT REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, name TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK ((owner_user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (organization_id IS NOT NULL)) ) STRICT
table organization_groups: CREATE TABLE organization_groups ( organization_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, gateway_group TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES gateway_groups(name) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY (organization_id, gateway_group) ) STRICT
table organizations: CREATE TABLE organizations ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(revision) > 0), created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ) STRICT
trigger dots_reject_owner_update: CREATE TRIGGER dots_reject_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF principal_id, owner_user_id, organization_id ON dots WHEN NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT OLD.owner_user_id OR NEW.organization_id IS NOT OLD.organization_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Dot ownership is immutable'); END
trigger organization_groups_reject_update: CREATE TRIGGER organization_groups_reject_update BEFORE UPDATE ON organization_groups BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Organization membership bindings must be replaced'); END
trigger organization_groups_rotate_revision_after_delete: CREATE TRIGGER organization_groups_rotate_revision_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON organization_groups BEGIN UPDATE organizations SET revision = lower(hex(randomblob(16))), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = OLD.organization_id; END
trigger organization_groups_rotate_revision_after_insert: CREATE TRIGGER organization_groups_rotate_revision_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON organization_groups BEGIN UPDATE organizations SET revision = lower(hex(randomblob(16))), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = NEW.organization_id; END
trigger personal_dot_workspace_cleanup_after_delete: CREATE TRIGGER personal_dot_workspace_cleanup_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON dots WHEN OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO dot_workspace_cleanup (dot_id, owner_user_id, created_at, next_attempt_at) VALUES (OLD.principal_id, OLD.owner_user_id, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')); END
trigger personal_dots_delete_principals_before_owner_delete: CREATE TRIGGER personal_dots_delete_principals_before_owner_delete BEFORE DELETE ON users BEGIN DELETE FROM system_principals WHERE id IN ( SELECT principal_id FROM dots WHERE owner_user_id = OLD.id ); END
